component.name: Ozone
component.summary: Describe an app and watch it get built

description.p: Ozone builds apps from a description. It creates the app from a tested template, runs it with Docker Compose, hands the work to coding agents and checks every step itself.
Ozone is a fork of T3 Code and keeps what T3 Code does: threads, providers, checkpoints, the preview browser and remote access.
